# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Everyone who takes part in Nova, whether by opening an issue, improving the brain, writing code or fixing the docs, deserves a respectful and harassment-free experience, regardless of age, background, identity, experience level or nationality.

## Expected behaviour

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new to the project or to programming.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person, and explain your reasoning.
- Accept constructive criticism gracefully and assume good intent.
- Keep discussions on topic and in public project spaces such as issues and pull requests.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, threats or discriminatory language.
- Personal attacks, trolling or sustained disruption of discussions.
- Publishing someone else's private information without permission.
- Brain contributions (topics, replies, jokes) that are hateful, harassing or sexually explicit. Nova's replies speak for the project.

## Enforcement

The maintainer, Angelo MT ([@gelowie](https://github.com/gelowie)), may edit, hide or delete comments, issues, pull requests and brain entries that break this code, and may temporarily or permanently block people who do so repeatedly or seriously.

To report a problem, contact the maintainer privately through [his GitHub profile](https://github.com/gelowie) or, for anything security-related, the [private advisory form](https://github.com/gelowie/nova-chatbot/security/advisories/new). Reports are handled privately.

## Scope

This code applies to all project spaces and to anyone representing the project in public.
